name: Mareth
role: Blade Master, Wyrm Trainer, Wife of Kaelrath
title: Reborn Blade
bio: Wyrm-touched blade master who was reborn by echo. She commands Emberheart's air forces and trains wyrm riders at the Wyrmflight Spires. Fierce, loyal, and protective of her children.
motivation: Ensure Emberheart's aerial supremacy and train the next generation of wyrm riders.
